name: tcp-close-drain
title: TCP close drain: keep the client-facing socket and alias until the client acknowledges the close
description: With the relay-end close now injected before the retire, 23-50 of 601 half-closing attempts still hang (2-8%): the crafted FIN is single-shot and the socket's own FIN plus any unacknowledged tail data die with the retired alias, so a close packet dropped at the client is never retransmitted. This task closes that gap (bounded close drain, or a bounded repeat of the crafted close) and measures it against the port budget.
creator: qmazon
